method: Built-in image-generator and direct pixel-matched master compositing
notes: Non-narrative faded-wool Bayeux scene dividers and pixel-matched winter seam continuations rendered in fixed cloth material coordinates along panel joins. Existing narrative masters and scientific border atlases remain untouched.
assembly: Isolated image-generator outputs on solid #FFFFFF backgrounds were matted to RGBA via exterior flood-fill background removal with 2px rim anti-aliasing, scaled with LANCZOS resampling to target strip heights (360px upright dividers, 160px harbour quay, 120px snow slope), and packed with 12px transparent gutters into a 2-row 928x556 RGBA PNG master plus WebP derivative (quality 90).

palm-shore.description: Faded-wool Bayeux tropical palm and fern shoreline taper completing the cropped Columbian Exchange island edge into open linen.
palm-shore.prompt: Isolated medieval Bayeux-Tapestry-style wool-embroidered tropical palm and fern shoreline edge motif on pure white (#FFFFFF), faded sage/olive/ochre wool threads matching opening-0 palm foliage, tapering naturally rightward into open linen.

winter-tree.description: Snow-dusted intertwined bare winter Bayeux divider tree rooted in a small snowdrift base.
winter-tree.prompt: Isolated medieval Bayeux-Tapestry-style faded-wool embroidered bare intertwined winter tree with delicate snow-dusted branches and small snowdrift base on pure white (#FFFFFF), soft umber stem-stitch outlines.

trench-post.description: Weathered timber trench post with crossed rope lashing and knee-high stacked WWI burlap sandbag parapet on muddy earth.
trench-post.prompt: Isolated upright-L-shaped medieval Bayeux-Tapestry-style wool-embroidered weathered timber trench post with crossed rope lashing on the left third and knee-high stacked burlap sandbags over muddy earth with grass tufts and muted russet ground line on pure white (#FFFFFF).

ruined-pier.description: Broken terracotta-and-stone Bayeux archway pier with ivy and fallen rubble framing the WWII brick wall.
ruined-pier.prompt: Isolated medieval Bayeux-Tapestry-style faded-wool embroidered broken terracotta brick and stone ruined archway pier with sparse ivy and small rubble base on pure white (#FFFFFF).

join4-bridge.description: Pixel-matched continuation completing the clipped bare winter twigs on early-2 and S-curving the exact ivory snowbank and braided ochre-brown ground cord into early-3.
join4-bridge.derivation: Sampled snow and ochre-brown ground-cord tiles directly from early-2 (rows 438..608, scaled to 360px) and early-3 (rows 608..724, scaled to 360px), warped vertically across a 15.5px cubic smoothstep S-curve with 24px horizontal cross-feathers, and extended the three clipped right-edge twigs using percentiles sampled from early-2's branch pixels blurred at sigma=1.4px.

join5-bridge.description: Pixel-matched continuation rounding off the clipped lower-right olive-taupe bough on middle-0 and sloping both snowdrifts along the bridge angle into middle-1's flat snow and russet ground cord.
join5-bridge.derivation: Sampled snow highlight, taupe shadow, and ridge contour percentiles directly from middle-0 (rows 0..179) to paint back and foreground snowdrifts following the snowy bridge slope down into middle-1 (rows 179..383), bridged the 4px russet ground-cord step with cloned cord pixels from both rows, attached a scaled olive-taupe foliage tip cloned from middle-0's upper canopy, and carved alpha cleanly behind the Prussian soldier's rear boot.

harbour-quay.description: Low-profile weathered Bayeux stone harbour quay with wooden pilings, rope-coiled mooring bollard, slate-matched lapping surf, and sandy grassy embankment.
harbour-quay.prompt: Isolated low-profile medieval Bayeux-Tapestry-style wool-embroidered weathered stone harbour quay with wooden pilings, rope-coiled mooring bollard, lapping blue-slate waves on the left, and a grassy sandy slope on the right on pure white (#FFFFFF).

snow-slope-single.description: Embroidered downward-sloping warm-cream snowdrift ribbon with thin russet-brown stitched ground cord.
snow-slope-single.prompt: Isolated medieval Bayeux-Tapestry-style wool-embroidered horizontal snowdrift sloping smoothly down from left to right into flat low cream snow grounded by a thin continuous muted russet-brown stitched cord on pure white (#FFFFFF).
